(1) solve.sh: line 1 '#!/bin/bash', 'set -euo pipefail', LF only (cat -A shows no ^M); 'mkdir -p /app' then 'cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/' (same install pattern as template solve.sh) and 'rm -f -- "$database_path" "$database_path-wal" "$database_path-shm"' so no database is shipped (instruction.md:15 'start with no shipped database'). It writes nothing to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution, has no pkill, no NODE_ENV, no npm/pip install. Its extra guard resolves DB_PATH (default /app/app.db), refuses paths outside /app, and on a fresh install exits the /proc scan immediately when no db/wal/shm exists; I confirmed 'node - <path>' puts the path at process.argv[2] as the heredoc assumes. (2) Entry: server.js 'require(./src/index.js)'; index.js main thread calls bootstrap.start, which listens on Number(process.env.PORT || 3000) on 0.0.0.0 (bootstrap.js:43) and answers GET/HEAD /api/health before any DB work (bootstrap.js:20-23), matching instruction.md:13 and integration.md. The worker opens the DB and serves the UI and API through a proxy in the same process (index.js:447 binds 127.0.0.1:0). (3) DB_PATH: db.js:9 'process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname, '..', 'app.db')', which resolves to /app/app.db in /app and honours the DB_PATH that test.sh:109 injects for either /app or /tmp/submission. (4) Seeding is idempotent and atomic: seedIfEmpty returns when users > 0 and seeds inside one db.transaction (db.js:122-147). (5) Self-contained: the seed is read from beside the module (db.js:10), not /assets. src/seed_data.json and environment/assets/seed_data.json share sha256 a1c65c80.... Runtime requires are only express, better-sqlite3 and node built-ins. package.json pins express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1, both preinstalled globally in the agent Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile with NODE_PATH. No node_modules or symlinks are shipped (so the test.sh:72-83 symlink refusal is not triggered), and index.html loads only local /styles.css and /js/*.js. This empirically shows the worker-thread design resolves NODE_PATH packages, loads better-sqlite3 in the verifier image, and keeps data across a restart.
